name: Default
shortDescription: Real-time analytics database with the web console, a coordinator, broker, historical and MiddleManager, ZooKeeper and PostgreSQL metadata storage.

alerts.message: Basic authentication is enabled. Sign in to the web console as admin with the generated DRUID_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment settings. It only applies on the first start; change it later through the Druid user API, not in the environment.
The stack runs seven containers. Upstream recommends at least 6 GiB of memory for it; with less, services or ingestion tasks can be killed for running out of memory.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
